query: rule of thumb for KV-cache VRAM at a given context length and KV quant

tolerance: formula exact; any worked number requires the model's own config
verify: cross-check n_layers/n_kv_heads/head_dim against the model card AND llama.cpp's --ctx-size memory report at load
note: GQA: using n_heads instead of n_kv_heads is the common ~4x overestimate. This is class B not C because it is model-card arithmetic, not a fleet probe.
